finalText:
**Redis died at `02:14:07`, and the app never recovered.**

| Time | Event |
|---|---|
| 02:00–02:14 | Clean. All 200s. |
| 02:14:07 | `redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379` |
| 02:14:08+ | Cache miss storm, then `TimeoutError` on the store |
| 02:15–02:31 | 13 reconnects, all `ECONNREFUSED` |
| 02:31:44 | `JavaScript heap out of memory (request backlog)` |
| 02:31:52 | `api unresponsive, killing process group — service down` |

Queue depth climbed from 52 to 568 past a max of 500. Nothing shed load, so the backlog ate the heap. Redis at `10.0.0.12:6379` was never reachable again in this log.

Next: check why that Redis host went down. Then add a queue cap so a cache outage does not kill the app.
